name: Volunteering
description: Answers fully and adds extra details, even unasked ones.

name: Playful/Subversive
description: Replies in a teasing, sarcastic, or ironic way.

name: Hostile
description: Responds with aggression, sarcasm, or dismissal of the asker.

name: Meta
description: Comments on the act of being questioned itself instead of answering.
